## Running out of space at home or work? Here’s a detailed look at how self-storage in India works, the reasons behind its growing popularity, and why it takes the hassle out of finding storage options.


**[Self storage in India](https://stownest.com/self-storage)** lets you keep belongings safely outside your home or office, with pricing based on what you're actually storing rather than a fixed unit size. With StowNest, you can either use the packers and movers service for full pickup, packing, and delivery, or visit the warehouse yourself and handle your own goods, once arranged in advance through customer support. Either way, it takes the stress out of finding room for things you're not ready to let go of.


## **Understanding Self Storage**


Self storage is like having a place to temporarily store your things. This means you can get your things back at a later time. It's perfect for when you're moving and can't keep something you own. You can also use it to store things you only use for a single season, or things you need to store from a recent downsizing. Some people also use it for work and store things they have in excess that can't be stored at the office anymore. Something that is unique about self-storage in India is that it originally was only available in a select number of large cities and now is available in large cities across the entire country and is priced by the number of items stored, not overall space taken.


## **Reason For Storage Problems**


Most plans do not take into account a storage problem. New apartments are often smaller then the last. The relocation for a job means living out of boxes for a longer than expected period. Renovations for a home means temporarily relocating your possessions to another location while the home is renovated. While none of these are traumatic events, they all have the same effect: way too much stuff and way too little space.


The normal answer to a space problem is to move to a bigger house. However, this mean increasing your cost to rent by a lot for an entire room that you will have to pay for and have lots of boxes stored in.


## **How It Really Impacts People**


Stress doesn't just mean a lack of physical space. It means the burden of a cluttered space, the awkwardness of having to ask relatives to hold boxes for you, and the guilt you have from having to give away things you care about because you have no other place to put them. It means tension added to a process that, in theory, should be easy for people managing a house move with their family or businesses with growing inventory that requires additional storage.


## **Store What You Need, Priced for What You Actually Have**


Self storage is the answer. Instead of signing a lease for an entire extra room, you pay for however much space you need. Instead of shoving your stuff into a loft/balcony, you use that sweet, sweet warehousing space that's designed for that specific purpose.Also, services have popping up where they come to your house/office, collect your items, and store them for you! You never even have to deal with going to a self storage facility. Everything gets tracked for you, so you'll never forget what your stuff is, and even better, you can get it delivered anytime you want. They do everything for you.


There are even storage services where you can go to the storage facility to add/remove your items in person! Something about self storage makes this a lot less stressful, because you don't have to hassle deal with liquidboxes of your possessions anymore.


## **Who Uses Self Storage in India**


There are a lot of common reasons that people use self storage. These reasons can include, but are not limited to, moving between homes while the new residence is not ready, households choosing to downsize while keeping old belongings, renovating households, and small businesses that have outgrown their current space, but can't afford to jump to a full warehouse lease. What they all have in common is not the space they have, but the right kind of space that they have for what they store.


## **Why This Is Growing Across Indian Cities**


Self storage India is becoming more and more necessary as homes become smaller and work-related moves become more frequent. Prior to only a few metros being served, self storage has now spread to almost all of India's major cities, with some providers offering more convenient and flexible services than the clunky program of driving to a facility.


## **Making Space Doesn't Have To Be Stressful**


When things begin to pile up, it's generally either getting rid of things you'll later wish you hadn't, or wasting money on extra space you don't need. Self storage solves this problem. Your things are safe, and it costs you what you should reasonably pay.


Self storage India offers more convenience and flexibility than the traditional self storage options, making it easy to access storage from anywhere.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**1. What exactly is self storage?**


It provides you a space at a warehouse to store your belongings you can't accommodate in your house. You only pay for the space that you use.


**2. Does self storage exist throughout India, or just in urban areas?**


There is currently self storage in the major urban areas including Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, and Kolkata.


**3. How does self storage pricing work?**


You pay for the number of items stored, rather than the size of the warehouse space.


**4. Are my items covered during the time of storage?**


Yes, all items are covered to the amount of ₹2.5 lakhs with 24/7 security monitoring.


## **Key Takeaways**


-


Self Storage solve the problem of keeping your excess belongings outside of you home, while charging based on quantity.


-


There are many reasons for using self storage, like moving, downsizing, renovation, and even growing business inventory.


-


It usually saves money to rent storage for excess belongings rather than getting a bigger home.


-


There are many options in the market that include transportation for you like **[StowNest](https://stownest.com/self-storage)** who even allows you to take a trip to their warehouse if you want.


-


Now self storage has expanded from being a service in just the major metropolitan cities to almost all of India's major cities.
